summary_en: The video features a Grade 12 chemistry review session on hard water and ion exchange reactions, taught by Master Phạm Lê Thanh. It also integrates introductions to the learning environment, facilities, and student extracurricular activities at the Saigon International University (SIU) and the Asian International School.
